title: Hotfix: SLO enforcement regression causing premature circuit-breaker trips during regional failover
author: Aisha Khan
release_notes: Fixes SLO enforcement bug that caused circuit breakers to trigger during regional failovers; improves grace window and KV-cache handling. No API changes.
description:
Context: During an automated regional failover exercise (and observed in a production incident on 2026-02-19), SLO enforcement started counting cold-cache latency spikes as sustained violations which in turn caused circuit-breakers to trip aggressively and trigger cross-region failovers. Root cause: two interacting regressions introduced in recent batching/kv-cache changes:
1) slo_enforcer: the moving-window aggregator did not correctly tag requests that were in-flight during a region reroute as transient; these were being treated as hard latency violations.
2) kv-cache metrics: a race allowed stale hit/miss counters to be double-counted when shard leadership moved, inflating the perceived error/latency rate.
This PR: hotfix the SLO enforcement path so regional failovers (reroutes) are given a short grace window and in-flight requests are excluded from SLO aggregation; fix kv-cache metric bookkeeping during leadership changes; tighten circuit-breaker backoff (shorter initial cooldown but more conservative trip threshold during detected failover windows).

Changes (summary):
- runtime/slo/slo_enforcer.go: add per-region grace window (configurable, default 10s) and exclude rerouted in-flight requests from SLO aggregation.
- runtime/slo/aggregator_test.go: add unit tests simulating regional reroute and in-flight requests to assert no spurious SLO violations.
- gateway/circuitbreaker/circuit_breaker.lua: reduce sensitivity during grace window and add structured logging for trip reasons.
- infra/ops/regional_failover.tf: minor config tweak exposing grace window to ops via flag.
- runtime/kvcache/metrics.go: fix counter race during shard leadership change; add guard and unit tests.
- deployments/hotfix/README.md: rollout instructions and post-deploy verification steps.

Checklist:
- [x] Reproduced regression locally and in canary cluster
- [x] Unit tests added (aggregator + kv-cache race)
- [x] E2E/regional-failover test added to perf-canary harness for future regression detection
- [x] CI green on rerun after flaky test fix
- [x] Ops notified; hotfix rollout documented

Motivation and risk: This is a customer-impacting reliability regression that can cause mass cross-region failovers and increased tail latency. Changes are limited and gate by a short grace window default; no public API changes. Rollout plan includes staged canary then global rollout with quick rollback path.
